posts.post: Friendly reminder that the 'grind' isn't the problem. The problem is that you are grinding on low-leverage activities. If you are exhausted but your net worth is flat, you are working on the wrong mechanics. Stop working harder. Start paying off your ignorance debt.

The moment you understand that your wardrobe is a communication tool, you stop buying brands that hide who you are. Average men wear labels to gain status. Exceptional men wear intention to gain respect. Be the latter.

Fun fact: Your comfort zone is a high-interest loan. It feels good now. It destroys your future capacity. The only way to win is to intentionally seek the things that make you feel like an amateur again. Stay uncomfortable.
